notice.title: 1492 Public Notice Dated: 14.08.2021 BABASAHEB BHIMRAO AMBEDKAR UNIVERSITY (BBAU) ENTRANCE TEST - 2021 Read More

clauses.text: Candidates who desire to appear in BBAU Entrance Test-2021 may apply online on the website https://bbauet.nta.nic.in, www.nta.ac.in and the details of Course Code, Eligibility Criteria, Course Structure etc. are available on the Information Bulletin
Before applying for BBAU Entrance Test-2021, candidates are advised to check the eligibility criteria required by the University for a desired Programme
